1: # Stormfall Royale
2: 
3: A fast, mobile-first battle royale that runs entirely in the browser. Drop onto a stylized island, loot chests, outlast the shrinking storm, and be the last of 16 fighters standing. Built as an original game — no Fortnite assets, branding, or trademarks.
4: 
5: **Play:** open `index.html` through any static server, or run `PORT=3002 ./start.sh` from this folder.
6: 
7: ## Features
8: 
9: - **16-player solo match** — you versus 15 bots with drop, loot, and combat AI.
10: - **Touch-first controls** — virtual joystick, drag-to-aim, and large action buttons with safe-area-aware HUD.
11: - **Optional tilt aiming** — lean your phone to fine-tune your shot. On iOS, motion access is requested from a user gesture (the tilt switch) and can be revoked at any time.
12: - **Desktop controls** — WASD movement, pointer-lock mouse aim, click to fire, plus full keyboard shortcuts.
13: - **Five points of interest** — each with its own silhouette, loot density, and chest placement.
14: - **Loot and rarities** — chests and floor loot grant weapons, shield potions, and building materials. Five rarity tiers from common to legendary.
15: - **Two weapon slots + pickaxe** — swap instantly, reload, and harvest wood with the pickaxe.
16: - **Building** — place walls and ramps in real time using harvested wood.
17: - **Shrinking storm** — multiple phases with escalating damage, visible storm wall, and a live minimap.
18: - **Original audiovisual style** — procedural low-poly island, stylized characters and gliders, synthesized WebAudio sound effects, and locally vendored fonts.
19: - **Full match flow** — menu, drop/glide intro, live HUD, killfeed, victory and defeat screens with stats, pause, settings, and instant rematch.
20: - **Performance options** — high and balanced quality presets; auto-pauses when the tab is hidden.
21: 
22: ## Controls
23: 
24: ### Desktop
25: 
26: | Action | Input |
27: | --- | --- |
28: | Move | `W` `A` `S` `D` or arrow keys |
29: | Sprint | `Shift` |
30: | Aim | Mouse (click the game to lock the pointer) |
31: | Fire | Left click |
32: | Aim down sights | Right click |
33: | Jump | `Space` |
34: | Reload | `R` |
35: | Build mode | `B` |
36: | Cycle build piece | `Q` |
37: | Place build | Left click or `F` |
38: | Switch weapon / pickaxe | `X` or `1` `2` `3` |
39: | Interact / open chest | `E` |
40: | Pause | `Esc` |
41: 
42: ### Mobile / tablet
43: 
44: | Action | Input |
45: | --- | --- |
46: | Move | Left virtual joystick |
47: | Aim | Drag anywhere on the right side of the screen |
48: | Fire | Fire button (hold for automatic weapons) |
49: | Aim down sights | Aim button |
50: | Jump | Jump button |
51: | Reload | Reload button |
52: | Build / place | Build button, then tap the placement control |
53: | Switch weapon | Weapon slot buttons |
54: | Open chest | Interact button when prompted |
55: | Tilt aim | Settings → Tilt aiming (optional) |
56: 
57: The touch HUD appears automatically on coarse-pointer devices or narrow viewports, and respects display safe areas (notches, home indicators).
58: 
59: ## Project layout
60: 
61: ```
62: index.html          Markup, HUD, menus, modals, import map
63: styles.css          Responsive visual system and touch layout
64: src/main.js         Game boot, match loop, combat bridge, flow
65: src/player.js       Player controller, camera, shooting, building
66: src/bot.js          Bot models, drop, AI, combat
67: src/world.js        Island, POIs, colliders, chests, storm
68: src/character.js    Character, glider, and health-bar models
69: src/weapons.js      Weapon stats, rarities, procedural meshes
70: src/input.js        Touch, keyboard, mouse, and tilt input
71: src/ui.js           HUD, minimap, menus, killfeed, end screens
72: src/fx.js           Particles, tracers, muzzle flash
73: src/audio.js        Synthesized WebAudio sound effects
74: vendor/             Locally vendored Three.js
75: assets/             Locally vendored fonts
76: ```
77: 
78: ## Technical notes
79: 
80: - No build step and no framework; ES modules load directly via an import map.
81: - Three.js is vendored locally, so the game works offline once served.
82: - All geometry, textures, and sound effects are generated procedurally at runtime.
83: - Rendering falls back gracefully on software GPUs; use the Balanced quality preset for lower-end devices.

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

1: # Stormfall Royale
2: 
3: A fast, mobile-first battle royale that runs entirely in the browser. Drop onto a stylized island, loot chests, outlast the shrinking storm, and be the last of 16 fighters standing. Built as an original game — no Fortnite assets, branding, or trademarks.
4: 
5: **Play:** open `index.html` through any static server, or run `PORT=3002 ./start.sh` from this folder.
6: 
7: ## Features
8: 
9: - **16-player solo match** — you versus 15 bots with drop, loot, and combat AI.
10: - **Touch-first controls** — virtual joystick, drag-to-aim, and large action buttons with safe-area-aware HUD.
11: - **Optional tilt aiming** — lean your phone to fine-tune your shot. On iOS, motion access is requested from a user gesture (the tilt switch) and can be revoked at any time.
12: - **Desktop controls** — WASD movement, pointer-lock mouse aim, click to fire, plus full keyboard shortcuts.
13: - **Five points of interest** — each with its own silhouette, loot density, and chest placement.
14: - **Loot and rarities** — chests and floor loot grant weapons, shield potions, and building materials. Five rarity tiers from common to legendary.
15: - **Two weapon slots + pickaxe** — swap instantly, reload, and harvest wood with the pickaxe.
16: - **Building** — place walls and ramps in real time using harvested wood.
17: - **Shrinking storm** — multiple phases with escalating damage, visible storm wall, and a live minimap.
18: - **Original audiovisual style** — procedural low-poly island, stylized characters and gliders, synthesized WebAudio sound effects, and locally vendored fonts.
19: - **Full match flow** — menu, drop/glide intro, live HUD, killfeed, victory and defeat screens with stats, pause, settings, and instant rematch.
20: - **Performance options** — high and balanced quality presets; auto-pauses when the tab is hidden.
21: 
22: ## Controls
23: 
24: ### Desktop
25: 
26: | Action | Input |
27: | --- | --- |
28: | Move | `W` `A` `S` `D` or arrow keys |
29: | Sprint | `Shift` |
30: | Aim | Mouse (click the game to lock the pointer) |
31: | Fire | Left click |
32: | Aim down sights | Right click |
33: | Jump | `Space` |
34: | Reload | `R` |
35: | Build mode | `B` |
36: | Cycle build piece | `Q` |
37: | Place build | Left click or `F` |
38: | Switch weapon / pickaxe | `X` or `1` `2` `3` |
39: | Interact / open chest | `E` |
40: | Pause | `Esc` |
41: 
42: ### Mobile / tablet
43: 
44: | Action | Input |
45: | --- | --- |
46: | Move | Left virtual joystick |
47: | Aim | Drag anywhere on the right side of the screen |
48: | Fire | Fire button (hold for automatic weapons) |
49: | Aim down sights | Aim button |
50: | Jump | Jump button |
51: | Reload | Reload button |
52: | Build / place | Build button, then tap the placement control |
53: | Switch weapon | Weapon slot buttons |
54: | Open chest | Interact button when prompted |
55: | Tilt aim | Settings → Tilt aiming (optional) |
56: 
57: The touch HUD appears automatically on coarse-pointer devices or narrow viewports, and respects display safe areas (notches, home indicators).
58: 
59: ## Project layout
60: 
61: ```
62: index.html          Markup, HUD, menus, modals, import map
63: styles.css          Responsive visual system and touch layout
64: src/main.js         Game boot, match loop, combat bridge, flow
65: src/player.js       Player controller, camera, shooting, building
66: src/bot.js          Bot models, drop, AI, combat
67: src/world.js        Island, POIs, colliders, chests, storm
68: src/character.js    Character, glider, and health-bar models
69: src/weapons.js      Weapon stats, rarities, procedural meshes
70: src/input.js        Touch, keyboard, mouse, and tilt input
71: src/ui.js           HUD, minimap, menus, killfeed, end screens
72: src/fx.js           Particles, tracers, muzzle flash
73: src/audio.js        Synthesized WebAudio sound effects
74: vendor/             Locally vendored Three.js
75: assets/             Locally vendored fonts
76: ```
77: 
78: ## Technical notes
79: 
80: - No build step and no framework; ES modules load directly via an import map.
81: - Three.js is vendored locally, so the game works offline once served.
82: - All geometry, textures, and sound effects are generated procedurally at runtime.
83: - Rendering falls back gracefully on software GPUs; use the Balanced quality preset for lower-end devices.

208:         if (world.heightAt(Math.cos(a) * m, Math.sin(a) * m) > 0.3) lo = m

211:       outer.push([Math.cos(a) * lo, Math.sin(a) * lo])

216:         else hi2 = m

219:     }
220:     return { outer, inner }

426:   update(dt) {
427:     if (!this.playing) return
428:     const game = this.game
429:     const player = game.player
430:     const storm = game.world.storm
431:     if (!player) return
432: 
433:     const alive = game.bots.reduce((n, b) => n + (b.alive ? 1 : 0), 0) + (player.alive ? 1 : 0)
434:     if (this.last.alive !== alive) {
435:       this.els.alive.textContent = alive
436:       this.last.alive = alive
437:     }
438: 
439:     const label = storm.label
440:     const time = storm.phase === 'final' ? '—' : fmtTime(storm.countdown)
441:     if (this.last.storm !== label + time) {
442:       this.els.stormTimer.textContent = time
443:       this.els.stormLabel.textContent = label
444:       this.els.stormPill.classList.toggle('danger', storm.countdown < 9 && storm.phase !== 'final')
445:       this.last.storm = label + time
446:     }
447:     const dots = this.els.phaseDots.children
448:     for (let i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) {
449:       dots[i].className = i < storm.index ? 'done' : i === storm.index ? 'now' : ''
450:     }
451: 
452:     const hp = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(player.hp))
453:     const sh = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(player.shield))
454:     this.els.healthFill.style.width = clamp((player.hp / player.maxHp) * 100, 0, 100) + '%'
455:     this.els.shieldFill.style.width = clamp((player.shield / player.maxShield) * 100, 0, 100) + '%'
456:     if (this.last.hp !== hp) { this.els.healthText.textContent = hp; this.last.hp = hp }
457:     if (this.last.sh !== sh) { this.els.shieldText.textContent = sh; this.last.sh = sh }
458:     this.els.healthRow.classList.toggle('low', player.hp < 35)
459:     const low = player.hp < 35 && player.alive ? 0.3 + Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.006) * 0.16 : 0
460:     this.els.lowHealth.style.opacity = low.toFixed(2)
461: 
462:     const wood = Math.floor(player.wood)
463:     if (this.last.wood !== wood) {
464:       this.els.wood.textContent = wood
465:       this.els.buildWood.textContent = wood
466:       this.last.wood = wood
467:     }
468: 
469:     const current = player.current
470:     if (this.last.slot !== current) {
471:       this.els.weaponSlots.forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle('active', i === current))
472:       this.last.slot = current
473:     }
474:     this._updateSlots(player)
475: 
476:     this.els.reloadRing.classList.toggle('show', player.reloadT > 0)
477:     if (player.reloadT > 0 && player.reloadTotal > 0) {
478:       this.els.reloadRing.style.setProperty('--p', String(1 - player.reloadT / player.reloadTotal))
479:     }
480: 
481:     this._updateMinimap(dt, player, storm, game)
482:     this._updateLocation(player, game)
483: 
484:     this.bloom = Math.max(0, this.bloom - dt * 2.4)
485:     const gap = (this.aiming ? 4 : 7) + this.bloom * 9
486:     this.els.crosshair.style.setProperty('--gap', gap.toFixed(1) + 'px')
487: 
488:     this.damageFlash = Math.max(0, this.damageFlash - dt * 1.8)
489:     this.els.damageVignette.style.opacity = (this.damageFlash * 0.9).toFixed(2)
490:     const outside = storm.outside(player.pos.x, player.pos.z, 0.5) && player.state === 'active'
491:     this.stormOpacity = lerp(this.stormOpacity, outside ? 0.85 : 0, 1 - Math.exp(-3 * dt))
492:     this.els.stormVignette.style.opacity = this.stormOpacity.toFixed(2)
493: 
494:     const tiltOn = Boolean(player.input?.tiltOn)
495:     const tiltStatus = player.input?.tiltStatus
496:     if (this.last.tiltOn !== tiltOn || this.last.tiltStatus !== tiltStatus) {
497:       this.last.tiltOn = tiltOn
498:       this.last.tiltStatus = tiltStatus
499:       this._syncTiltUI()
500:       this.setTiltBadge(tiltOn)
501:     }
502:   }

545:     let best = null

551:     const name = best ? best.name.toUpperCase() : player.state === 'drop' ? 'DROPPING IN' : 'THE WILDS'

558:   _updateMinimap(dt, player, storm, game) {
559:     this.mapAccum += dt
560:     if (this.mapAccum < 0.1) return
561:     this.mapAccum = 0
562:     const ctx = this.ctx
563:     const size = 188
564:     const c = size / 2
565:     const scale = 88 / 300
566:     const M = (x, z) => [c + x * scale, c + z * scale]
567: 
568:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size)
569:     const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(c, c, 10, c, c, c)

1: # Stormfall Royale
2: 
3: A fast, mobile-first battle royale that runs entirely in the browser. Drop onto a stylized island, loot chests, outlast the shrinking storm, and be the last of 16 fighters standing. Built as an original game — no Fortnite assets, branding, or trademarks.
4: 
5: **Play:** open `index.html` through any static server, or run `PORT=3002 ./start.sh` from this folder.
6: 
7: ## Features
8: 
9: - **16-player solo match** — you versus 15 bots with drop, loot, and combat AI.
10: - **Touch-first controls** — virtual joystick, drag-to-aim, and large action buttons with safe-area-aware HUD.
11: - **Optional tilt aiming** — lean your phone to fine-tune your shot. On iOS, motion access is requested from a user gesture (the tilt switch) and can be revoked at any time.
12: - **Desktop controls** — WASD movement, pointer-lock mouse aim, click to fire, plus full keyboard shortcuts.
13: - **Five points of interest** — each with its own silhouette, loot density, and chest placement.
14: - **Loot and rarities** — chests and floor loot grant weapons, shield potions, and building materials. Five rarity tiers from common to legendary.
15: - **Two weapon slots + pickaxe** — swap instantly, reload, and harvest wood with the pickaxe.
16: - **Building** — place walls and ramps in real time using harvested wood.
17: - **Shrinking storm** — multiple phases with escalating damage, visible storm wall, and a live minimap.
18: - **Original audiovisual style** — procedural low-poly island, stylized characters and gliders, synthesized WebAudio sound effects, and locally vendored fonts.
19: - **Full match flow** — menu, drop/glide intro, live HUD, killfeed, victory and defeat screens with stats, pause, settings, and instant rematch.
20: - **Performance options** — high and balanced quality presets; auto-pauses when the tab is hidden.
21: 
22: ## Controls
23: 
24: ### Desktop
25: 
26: | Action | Input |
27: | --- | --- |
28: | Move | `W` `A` `S` `D` or arrow keys |
29: | Sprint | `Shift` |
30: | Aim | Mouse (click the game to lock the pointer) |
31: | Fire | Left click |
32: | Aim down sights | Right click |
33: | Jump | `Space` |
34: | Reload | `R` |
35: | Build mode | `B` |
36: | Cycle build piece | `Q` |
37: | Place build | Left click or `F` |
38: | Switch weapon / pickaxe | `X` or `1` `2` `3` |
39: | Interact / open chest | `E` |
40: | Pause | `Esc` |
41: 
42: ### Mobile / tablet
43: 
44: | Action | Input |
45: | --- | --- |
46: | Move | Left virtual joystick |
47: | Aim | Drag anywhere on the right side of the screen |
48: | Fire | Fire button (hold for automatic weapons) |
49: | Aim down sights | Aim button |
50: | Jump | Jump button |
51: | Reload | Reload button |
52: | Build / place | Build button, then tap the placement control |
53: | Switch weapon | Weapon slot buttons |
54: | Open chest | Interact button when prompted |
55: | Tilt aim | Settings → Tilt aiming (optional) |
56: 
57: The touch HUD appears automatically on coarse-pointer devices or narrow viewports, and respects display safe areas (notches, home indicators).
58: 
59: ## Project layout
60: 
61: ```
62: index.html          Markup, HUD, menus, modals, import map
63: styles.css          Responsive visual system and touch layout
64: src/main.js         Game boot, match loop, combat bridge, flow
65: src/player.js       Player controller, camera, shooting, building
66: src/bot.js          Bot models, drop, AI, combat
67: src/world.js        Island, POIs, colliders, chests, storm
68: src/character.js    Character, glider, and health-bar models
69: src/weapons.js      Weapon stats, rarities, procedural meshes
70: src/input.js        Touch, keyboard, mouse, and tilt input
71: src/ui.js           HUD, minimap, menus, killfeed, end screens
72: src/fx.js           Particles, tracers, muzzle flash
73: src/audio.js        Synthesized WebAudio sound effects
74: vendor/             Locally vendored Three.js
75: assets/             Locally vendored fonts
76: ```
77: 
78: ## Technical notes
79: 
80: - No build step and no framework; ES modules load directly via an import map.
81: - Three.js is vendored locally, so the game works offline once served.
82: - All geometry, textures, and sound effects are generated procedurally at runtime.
83: - Rendering falls back gracefully on software GPUs; use the Balanced quality preset for lower-end devices.

12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.

## Objective
- Complete the existing Stormfall Royale game by identifying and fixing remaining gaps, then verify the playable experience.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Inspect the existing game and identify remaining gaps before making changes.

- Inspected the README and core game flow, UI, player, and bot implementations.
- Opened the game in Chromium; confirmed the menu renders and starting a match reaches gameplay.
- Confirmed the browser console has no errors; observed WebGL GPU-stall warnings.

### Active
- Investigate and fix a likely pointer-interaction defect: clicking the in-game pause button times out because the game canvas intercepts pointer events.
- Continue testing pause/resume, settings, gameplay, and match-end flow after the interaction issue is fixed.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Inspect computed styles and hit-testing around `#pauseBtn` and `#game` to find why the canvas intercepts clicks.
2. Fix the UI/canvas layering or pointer-event behavior, then verify pause and resume in the browser.
3. Test remaining match flows, fix any issues found, and report changes and assumptions.

- `styles.css`: Canvas, HUD, modal, and screen stacking and pointer-event rules.
- `index.html`: Game canvas, HUD, pause button, and dialogs.
- `src/main.js`: Game boot, match flow, and pause-related state.
- `src/ui.js`: Pause, resume, settings, and end-screen controls.
- `README.md`: Feature overview and controls.

## Important Context
- `http://localhost:3002` returns HTTP 200; a match starts from the menu and displays gameplay.
- `playwright-cli click e69` timed out; Playwright reported `#game` intercepted pointer events intended for `#pauseBtn`.
- An attempted browser style/hit-test inspection failed with `SyntaxError: missing ) after argument list`; repeat with valid `playwright-cli run-code` syntax.
- No source files have been changed. Browser screenshots were saved under `screenshots/`.

206:       for (let k = 0; k < 18; k++) {

208:         if (world.heightAt(Math.cos(a) * m, Math.sin(a) * m) > 0.3) lo = m
209:         else hi = m

211:       outer.push([Math.cos(a) * lo, Math.sin(a) * lo])
212:       let lo2 = 20, hi2 = lo
213:       for (let k = 0; k < 14; k++) {

215:         if (world.heightAt(Math.cos(a) * m, Math.sin(a) * m) > 2.2) lo2 = m
216:         else hi2 = m
217:       }
218:       inner.push([Math.cos(a) * lo2, Math.sin(a) * lo2])
219:     }
220:     return { outer, inner }
221:   }

426:   update(dt) {
427:     if (!this.playing) return
428:     const game = this.game
429:     const player = game.player
430:     const storm = game.world.storm
431:     if (!player) return
432: 
433:     const alive = game.bots.reduce((n, b) => n + (b.alive ? 1 : 0), 0) + (player.alive ? 1 : 0)
434:     if (this.last.alive !== alive) {
435:       this.els.alive.textContent = alive
436:       this.last.alive = alive
437:     }
438: 
439:     const label = storm.label
440:     const time = storm.phase === 'final' ? '—' : fmtTime(storm.countdown)
441:     if (this.last.storm !== label + time) {
442:       this.els.stormTimer.textContent = time
443:       this.els.stormLabel.textContent = label
444:       this.els.stormPill.classList.toggle('danger', storm.countdown < 9 && storm.phase !== 'final')
445:       this.last.storm = label + time
446:     }
447:     const dots = this.els.phaseDots.children
448:     for (let i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) {
449:       dots[i].className = i < storm.index ? 'done' : i === storm.index ? 'now' : ''
450:     }
451: 
452:     const hp = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(player.hp))
453:     const sh = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(player.shield))
454:     this.els.healthFill.style.width = clamp((player.hp / player.maxHp) * 100, 0, 100) + '%'
455:     this.els.shieldFill.style.width = clamp((player.shield / player.maxShield) * 100, 0, 100) + '%'
456:     if (this.last.hp !== hp) { this.els.healthText.textContent = hp; this.last.hp = hp }
457:     if (this.last.sh !== sh) { this.els.shieldText.textContent = sh; this.last.sh = sh }
458:     this.els.healthRow.classList.toggle('low', player.hp < 35)
459:     const low = player.hp < 35 && player.alive ? 0.3 + Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.006) * 0.16 : 0
460:     this.els.lowHealth.style.opacity = low.toFixed(2)
461: 
462:     const wood = Math.floor(player.wood)
463:     if (this.last.wood !== wood) {
464:       this.els.wood.textContent = wood
465:       this.els.buildWood.textContent = wood
466:       this.last.wood = wood
467:     }
468: 
469:     const current = player.current
470:     if (this.last.slot !== current) {
471:       this.els.weaponSlots.forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle('active', i === current))
472:       this.last.slot = current
473:     }
474:     this._updateSlots(player)
475: 
476:     this.els.reloadRing.classList.toggle('show', player.reloadT > 0)
477:     if (player.reloadT > 0 && player.reloadTotal > 0) {
478:       this.els.reloadRing.style.setProperty('--p', String(1 - player.reloadT / player.reloadTotal))
479:     }
480: 
481:     this._updateMinimap(dt, player, storm, game)
482:     this._updateLocation(player, game)
483: 
484:     this.bloom = Math.max(0, this.bloom - dt * 2.4)
485:     const gap = (this.aiming ? 4 : 7) + this.bloom * 9
486:     this.els.crosshair.style.setProperty('--gap', gap.toFixed(1) + 'px')
487: 
488:     this.damageFlash = Math.max(0, this.damageFlash - dt * 1.8)
489:     this.els.damageVignette.style.opacity = (this.damageFlash * 0.9).toFixed(2)
490:     const outside = storm.outside(player.pos.x, player.pos.z, 0.5) && player.state === 'active'
491:     this.stormOpacity = lerp(this.stormOpacity, outside ? 0.85 : 0, 1 - Math.exp(-3 * dt))
492:     this.els.stormVignette.style.opacity = this.stormOpacity.toFixed(2)
493: 
494:     const tiltOn = Boolean(player.input?.tiltOn)
495:     const tiltStatus = player.input?.tiltStatus
496:     if (this.last.tiltOn !== tiltOn || this.last.tiltStatus !== tiltStatus) {
497:       this.last.tiltOn = tiltOn
498:       this.last.tiltStatus = tiltStatus
499:       this._syncTiltUI()
500:       this.setTiltBadge(tiltOn)
501:     }
502:   }

542:   _updateLocation(player, game) {

558:   _updateMinimap(dt, player, storm, game) {
559:     this.mapAccum += dt
560:     if (this.mapAccum < 0.1) return
561:     this.mapAccum = 0
562:     const ctx = this.ctx
563:     const size = 188
564:     const c = size / 2
565:     const scale = 88 / 300
566:     const M = (x, z) => [c + x * scale, c + z * scale]
567: 
568:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size)
569:     const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(c, c, 10, c, c, c)
570:     bg.addColorStop(0, '#0f4d66')
571:     bg.addColorStop(1, '#082638')
572:     ctx.fillStyle = bg
573:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size)
574:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160, 220, 255, 0.07)'
575:     ctx.lineWidth = 1
576:     for (let r = 30; r < 100; r += 25) {
577:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c, c, r, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke()
578:     }
579:     // island
580:     ctx.beginPath()
581:     this._coast.outer.forEach(([x, z], i) => {
582:       const [px, py] = M(x, z)
583:       i ? ctx.lineTo(px, py) : ctx.moveTo(px, py)
584:     })
585:     ctx.closePath()
586:     ctx.fillStyle = '#d9c292'
587:     ctx.fill()
588:     ctx.lineWidth = 2
589:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 235, 190, 0.5)'
590:     ctx.stroke()
591:     ctx.beginPath()
592:     this._coast.inner.forEach(([x, z], i) => {
593:       const [px, py] = M(x, z)
594:       i ? ctx.lineTo(px, py) : ctx.moveTo(px, py)
595:     })
596:     ctx.closePath()
597:     const land = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, size)
598:     land.addColorStop(0, '#7fb967')
599:     land.addColorStop(1, '#5b9d58')
600:     ctx.fillStyle = land
601:     ctx.fill()
602:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(38, 83, 52, 0.35)'
603:     ctx.lineWidth = 1
604:     ctx.stroke()
605: 
606:     // POIs
607:     for (const p of this.game.world.poiMarkers || []) {
608:       const [px, py] = M(p.x, p.z)
609:       ctx.beginPath()
610:       ctx.arc(px, py, 3.4, 0, TAU)
611:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 16, 30, 0.65)'
612:       ctx.fill()
613:       ctx.beginPath()
614:       ctx.arc(px, py, 2, 0, TAU)
615:       ctx.fillStyle = p.color || '#ffda7a'
616:       ctx.fill()
617:       if (size > 150) {
618:         ctx.font = '600 7px Outfit, sans-serif'
619:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.65)'
620:         ctx.textAlign = 'center'
621:         ctx.fillText(p.name.toUpperCase(), px, py + 10)
622:       }
623:     }
624: 
625:     // storm: shade everything outside the safe circle
626:     const [sx, sy] = M(storm.center.x, storm.center.y)
627:     const sr = storm.radius * scale
628:     ctx.save()
629:     ctx.beginPath()
630:     ctx.rect(0, 0, size, size)
631:     ctx.arc(sx, sy, Math.max(0, sr), 0, TAU, true)
632:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(153, 83, 255, 0.36)'
633:     ctx.fill('evenodd')
634:     ctx.restore()
635:     ctx.beginPath()
636:     ctx.arc(sx, sy, Math.max(0, sr), 0, TAU)
637:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200, 160, 255, 0.9)'
638:     ctx.lineWidth = 1.6
639:     ctx.stroke()
640: 
641:     const next = storm.nextCircle
642:     if (next) {
643:       const [nx, ny] = M(next.x, next.z)
644:       ctx.save()
645:       ctx.setLineDash([4, 3])
646:       ctx.beginPath()
647:       ctx.arc(nx, ny, next.r * scale, 0, TAU)
648:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.75)'
649:       ctx.lineWidth = 1.2
650:       ctx.stroke()
651:       ctx.restore()
652:     }
653: 
654:     // enemies within radar range
655:     for (const bot of game.bots) {
656:       if (!bot.alive) continue
657:       const d = Math.hypot(bot.pos.x - player.pos.x, bot.pos.z - player.pos.z)
658:       if (d > 85) continue
659:       const [bx, by] = M(bot.pos.x, bot.pos.z)
660:       ctx.beginPath()
661:       ctx.arc(bx, by, 2.2, 0, TAU)
662:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b5b'
663:       ctx.shadowColor = '#ff5b5b'
664:       ctx.shadowBlur = 4
665:       ctx.fill()
666:       ctx.shadowBlur = 0
667:     }
668: 
669:     // player arrow
670:     const [px, py] = M(player.pos.x, player.pos.z)
671:     const fx = Math.sin(player.camYaw)
672:     const fz = Math.cos(player.camYaw)
673:     const rx = -Math.cos(player.camYaw)
674:     const rz = Math.sin(player.camYaw)
675:     const tipX = px + fx * 8
676:     const tipY = py + fz * 8
677:     const backX = px - fx * 4
678:     const backY = py - fz * 4
679:     ctx.beginPath()
680:     ctx.moveTo(tipX, tipY)
681:     ctx.lineTo(backX + rx * 5, backY + rz * 5)
682:     ctx.lineTo(backX - rx * 5, backY - rz * 5)

1: # Stormfall Royale
2: 
3: A fast, mobile-first battle royale that runs entirely in the browser. Drop onto a stylized island, loot chests, outlast the shrinking storm, and be the last of 16 fighters standing. Built as an original game — no Fortnite assets, branding, or trademarks.
4: 
5: **Play:** open `index.html` through any static server, or run `PORT=3002 ./start.sh` from this folder.
6: 
7: ## Features
8: 
9: - **16-player solo match** — you versus 15 bots with drop, loot, and combat AI.
10: - **Touch-first controls** — virtual joystick, drag-to-aim, and large action buttons with safe-area-aware HUD.
11: - **Optional tilt aiming** — lean your phone to fine-tune your shot. On iOS, motion access is requested from a user gesture (the tilt switch) and can be revoked at any time.
12: - **Desktop controls** — WASD movement, pointer-lock mouse aim, click to fire, plus full keyboard shortcuts.
13: - **Five points of interest** — each with its own silhouette, loot density, and chest placement.
14: - **Loot and rarities** — chests and floor loot grant weapons, shield potions, and building materials. Five rarity tiers from common to legendary.
15: - **Two weapon slots + pickaxe** — swap instantly, reload, and harvest wood with the pickaxe.
16: - **Building** — place walls and ramps in real time using harvested wood.
17: - **Shrinking storm** — multiple phases with escalating damage, visible storm wall, and a live minimap.
18: - **Original audiovisual style** — procedural low-poly island, stylized characters and gliders, synthesized WebAudio sound effects, and locally vendored fonts.
19: - **Full match flow** — menu, drop/glide intro, live HUD, killfeed, victory and defeat screens with stats, pause, settings, and instant rematch.
20: - **Performance options** — high and balanced quality presets; auto-pauses when the tab is hidden.
21: 
22: ## Controls
23: 
24: ### Desktop
25: 
26: | Action | Input |
27: | --- | --- |
28: | Move | `W` `A` `S` `D` or arrow keys |
29: | Sprint | `Shift` |
30: | Aim | Mouse (click the game to lock the pointer) |
31: | Fire | Left click |
32: | Aim down sights | Right click |
33: | Jump | `Space` |
34: | Reload | `R` |
35: | Build mode | `B` |
36: | Cycle build piece | `Q` |
37: | Place build | Left click or `F` |
38: | Switch weapon / pickaxe | `X` or `1` `2` `3` |
39: | Interact / open chest | `E` |
40: | Pause | `Esc` |
41: 
42: ### Mobile / tablet
43: 
44: | Action | Input |
45: | --- | --- |
46: | Move | Left virtual joystick |
47: | Aim | Drag anywhere on the right side of the screen |
48: | Fire | Fire button (hold for automatic weapons) |
49: | Aim down sights | Aim button |
50: | Jump | Jump button |
51: | Reload | Reload button |
52: | Build / place | Build button, then tap the placement control |
53: | Switch weapon | Weapon slot buttons |
54: | Open chest | Interact button when prompted |
55: | Tilt aim | Settings → Tilt aiming (optional) |
56: 
57: The touch HUD appears automatically on coarse-pointer devices or narrow viewports, and respects display safe areas (notches, home indicators).
58: 
59: ## Project layout
60: 
61: ```
62: index.html          Markup, HUD, menus, modals, import map
63: styles.css          Responsive visual system and touch layout
64: src/main.js         Game boot, match loop, combat bridge, flow
65: src/player.js       Player controller, camera, shooting, building
66: src/bot.js          Bot models, drop, AI, combat
67: src/world.js        Island, POIs, colliders, chests, storm
68: src/character.js    Character, glider, and health-bar models
69: src/weapons.js      Weapon stats, rarities, procedural meshes
70: src/input.js        Touch, keyboard, mouse, and tilt input
71: src/ui.js           HUD, minimap, menus, killfeed, end screens
72: src/fx.js           Particles, tracers, muzzle flash
73: src/audio.js        Synthesized WebAudio sound effects
74: vendor/             Locally vendored Three.js
75: assets/             Locally vendored fonts
76: ```
77: 
78: ## Technical notes
79: 
80: - No build step and no framework; ES modules load directly via an import map.
81: - Three.js is vendored locally, so the game works offline once served.
82: - All geometry, textures, and sound effects are generated procedurally at runtime.
83: - Rendering falls back gracefully on software GPUs; use the Balanced quality preset for lower-end devices.
84:

- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

- Inspect the existing game and identify remaining gaps before making changes.

- Read `styles.css`, `index.html`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/main.js` while investigating the pause-button issue.

### Active
- Investigate and fix the likely pointer-interaction defect: clicking the in-game pause button times out because the game canvas intercepts pointer events.
- Test pause/resume, settings, gameplay, and match-end flow after resolving the interaction issue.

- (none)

1. Inspect computed styles and hit-testing around `#pauseBtn` and `#game` using valid `playwright-cli run-code` syntax.

3. Test remaining match flows, fix any issues found, and report changes and assumptions.

- `styles.css`: Canvas, HUD, modal, and screen stacking and pointer-event rules.
- `index.html`: Game canvas, HUD, pause button, and dialogs.
- `src/main.js`: Game boot, match flow, and pause-related state.
- `src/ui.js`: Pause, resume, settings, and end-screen controls.
- `README.md`: Feature overview and controls.

## Important Context
- `http://localhost:3002` returns HTTP 200; gameplay starts from the menu.
- `playwright-cli click e69` timed out; Playwright reported `#game` intercepted pointer events intended for `#pauseBtn`.
- An earlier browser style/hit-test inspection failed with `SyntaxError: missing ) after argument list`; repeat with valid syntax.
- No source files have been changed; screenshots are under `screenshots/`.

## Objective
- Complete the existing Stormfall Royale game by finding and fixing remaining issues, then verify the playable experience.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Inspect the existing game and identify remaining gaps before making changes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the README, game flow, UI, player, and bot implementations.
- Opened the game in Chromium; confirmed the menu renders and a match starts.
- Confirmed the browser console has no errors; observed WebGL GPU-stall warnings.
- Reviewed `styles.css`, `index.html`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/main.js`.
- Confirmed no source files have been changed; `git status --short` was clean.

### Active
- Investigate and fix the pause-button interaction issue: clicking `#pauseBtn` times out because `#game` intercepts pointer events.
- Verify pause/resume, settings, gameplay, and match-end flow after the fix.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect computed styles and hit-testing around `#pauseBtn` and `#game` using valid `playwright-cli run-code` syntax.
2. Fix the UI/canvas layering or pointer-event behavior, then verify pause and resume in the browser.
3. Test remaining match flows, fix any issues found, and report changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `styles.css`: Canvas, HUD, modal, and screen stacking and pointer-event rules.
- `index.html`: Game canvas, HUD, pause button, and dialogs.
- `src/main.js`: Game boot, match flow, and pause-related state.
- `src/ui.js`: Pause, resume, settings, and end-screen controls.
- `README.md`: Feature overview and controls.

## Important Context
- `http://localhost:3002` returns HTTP 200; gameplay starts from the menu.
- `playwright-cli click e69` timed out; Playwright reported `#game` intercepted pointer events intended for `#pauseBtn`.
- An earlier browser style/hit-test inspection failed with `SyntaxError: missing ) after argument list`; repeat with valid syntax.
- Screenshots are under `screenshots/`.

587:     ctx.fill()

591:     ctx.beginPath()

613:       ctx.beginPath()

617:       if (size > 150) {

629:     ctx.beginPath()

631:     ctx.arc(sx, sy, Math.max(0, sr), 0, TAU, true)
632:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(153, 83, 255, 0.36)'

646:       ctx.beginPath()

649:       ctx.lineWidth = 1.2

554:   const b = ox * dir.x + oy * dir.y + oz * dir.z

1: # Stormfall Royale
2: 
3: A fast, mobile-first battle royale that runs entirely in the browser. Drop onto a stylized island, loot chests, outlast the shrinking storm, and be the last of 16 fighters standing. Built as an original game — no Fortnite assets, branding, or trademarks.
4: 
5: **Play:** open `index.html` through any static server, or run `PORT=3002 ./start.sh` from this folder.
6: 
7: ## Features
8: 
9: - **16-player solo match** — you versus 15 bots with drop, loot, and combat AI.
10: - **Touch-first controls** — virtual joystick, drag-to-aim, and large action buttons with safe-area-aware HUD.
11: - **Optional tilt aiming** — lean your phone to fine-tune your shot. On iOS, motion access is requested from a user gesture (the tilt switch) and can be revoked at any time.
12: - **Desktop controls** — WASD movement, pointer-lock mouse aim, click to fire, plus full keyboard shortcuts.
13: - **Five points of interest** — each with its own silhouette, loot density, and chest placement.
14: - **Loot and rarities** — chests and floor loot grant weapons, shield potions, and building materials. Five rarity tiers from common to legendary.
15: - **Two weapon slots + pickaxe** — swap instantly, reload, and harvest wood with the pickaxe.
16: - **Building** — place walls and ramps in real time using harvested wood.
17: - **Shrinking storm** — multiple phases with escalating damage, visible storm wall, and a live minimap.
18: - **Original audiovisual style** — procedural low-poly island, stylized characters and gliders, synthesized WebAudio sound effects, and locally vendored fonts.
19: - **Full match flow** — menu, drop/glide intro, live HUD, killfeed, victory and defeat screens with stats, pause, settings, and instant rematch.
20: - **Performance options** — high and balanced quality presets; auto-pauses when the tab is hidden.

64: src/main.js         Game boot, match loop, combat bridge, flow

## Objective
- Complete Stormfall Royale by fixing remaining issues and verifying the playable experience.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Inspect the existing game and identify remaining gaps before making changes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Confirmed the menu renders and a match starts; earlier testing observed no browser console errors and WebGL GPU-stall warnings.
- Reviewed pause UI markup, styles, and handlers; confirmed `#pauseBtn` calls `game.pause()` and the game accepts pauses only while playing.

### Active
- Diagnose and fix the pause-button interaction issue, then verify pause/resume and settings.
- Test gameplay and match-end flows; fix issues found.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Use valid `playwright-cli run-code` or `eval` syntax to inspect computed styles and `document.elementFromPoint()` around `#pauseBtn`.
2. Fix the UI/canvas layering or pointer-event behavior, then verify pause and resume in the browser.
3. Test settings, gameplay, and match-end flows; report changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `styles.css`: Canvas, HUD, modal, and screen stacking and pointer-event rules.
- `index.html`: Game canvas, HUD, pause button, and dialogs.
- `src/main.js`: Match flow and pause/resume state.
- `src/ui.js`: Pause, resume, settings, and end-screen controls.

## Important Context
- `http://localhost:3002` returns HTTP 200; gameplay starts from the menu.
- `playwright-cli click e69` timed out with `#game` intercepting pointer events intended for `#pauseBtn`.
- `.hud` has `pointer-events: none`; `.icon-btn` restores `pointer-events: auto`; `.hud` has `z-index: 7`; `#game` is positioned with no explicit `z-index`.
- An earlier browser style/hit-test inspection failed with `SyntaxError: missing ) after argument list`; repeat with valid syntax.
- No source files have been changed; the prior `git status --short` was clean.

206:       for (let k = 0; k < 18; k++) {

208:         if (world.heightAt(Math.cos(a) * m, Math.sin(a) * m) > 0.3) lo = m
209:         else hi = m

211:       outer.push([Math.cos(a) * lo, Math.sin(a) * lo])
212:       let lo2 = 20, hi2 = lo
213:       for (let k = 0; k < 14; k++) {

215:         if (world.heightAt(Math.cos(a) * m, Math.sin(a) * m) > 2.2) lo2 = m
216:         else hi2 = m
217:       }
218:       inner.push([Math.cos(a) * lo2, Math.sin(a) * lo2])
219:     }
220:     return { outer, inner }
221:   }

426:   update(dt) {
427:     if (!this.playing) return
428:     const game = this.game
429:     const player = game.player
430:     const storm = game.world.storm
431:     if (!player) return
432: 
433:     const alive = game.bots.reduce((n, b) => n + (b.alive ? 1 : 0), 0) + (player.alive ? 1 : 0)
434:     if (this.last.alive !== alive) {
435:       this.els.alive.textContent = alive
436:       this.last.alive = alive
437:     }
438: 
439:     const label = storm.label
440:     const time = storm.phase === 'final' ? '—' : fmtTime(storm.countdown)
441:     if (this.last.storm !== label + time) {
442:       this.els.stormTimer.textContent = time
443:       this.els.stormLabel.textContent = label
444:       this.els.stormPill.classList.toggle('danger', storm.countdown < 9 && storm.phase !== 'final')
445:       this.last.storm = label + time
446:     }
447:     const dots = this.els.phaseDots.children
448:     for (let i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) {
449:       dots[i].className = i < storm.index ? 'done' : i === storm.index ? 'now' : ''
450:     }
451: 
452:     const hp = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(player.hp))
453:     const sh = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(player.shield))
454:     this.els.healthFill.style.width = clamp((player.hp / player.maxHp) * 100, 0, 100) + '%'
455:     this.els.shieldFill.style.width = clamp((player.shield / player.maxShield) * 100, 0, 100) + '%'
456:     if (this.last.hp !== hp) { this.els.healthText.textContent = hp; this.last.hp = hp }
457:     if (this.last.sh !== sh) { this.els.shieldText.textContent = sh; this.last.sh = sh }
458:     this.els.healthRow.classList.toggle('low', player.hp < 35)
459:     const low = player.hp < 35 && player.alive ? 0.3 + Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.006) * 0.16 : 0
460:     this.els.lowHealth.style.opacity = low.toFixed(2)
461: 
462:     const wood = Math.floor(player.wood)
463:     if (this.last.wood !== wood) {
464:       this.els.wood.textContent = wood
465:       this.els.buildWood.textContent = wood
466:       this.last.wood = wood
467:     }
468: 
469:     const current = player.current
470:     if (this.last.slot !== current) {
471:       this.els.weaponSlots.forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle('active', i === current))
472:       this.last.slot = current
473:     }
474:     this._updateSlots(player)
475: 
476:     this.els.reloadRing.classList.toggle('show', player.reloadT > 0)
477:     if (player.reloadT > 0 && player.reloadTotal > 0) {
478:       this.els.reloadRing.style.setProperty('--p', String(1 - player.reloadT / player.reloadTotal))
479:     }
480: 
481:     this._updateMinimap(dt, player, storm, game)
482:     this._updateLocation(player, game)
483: 
484:     this.bloom = Math.max(0, this.bloom - dt * 2.4)
485:     const gap = (this.aiming ? 4 : 7) + this.bloom * 9
486:     this.els.crosshair.style.setProperty('--gap', gap.toFixed(1) + 'px')
487: 
488:     this.damageFlash = Math.max(0, this.damageFlash - dt * 1.8)
489:     this.els.damageVignette.style.opacity = (this.damageFlash * 0.9).toFixed(2)
490:     const outside = storm.outside(player.pos.x, player.pos.z, 0.5) && player.state === 'active'
491:     this.stormOpacity = lerp(this.stormOpacity, outside ? 0.85 : 0, 1 - Math.exp(-3 * dt))
492:     this.els.stormVignette.style.opacity = this.stormOpacity.toFixed(2)
493: 
494:     const tiltOn = Boolean(player.input?.tiltOn)
495:     const tiltStatus = player.input?.tiltStatus
496:     if (this.last.tiltOn !== tiltOn || this.last.tiltStatus !== tiltStatus) {
497:       this.last.tiltOn = tiltOn
498:       this.last.tiltStatus = tiltStatus
499:       this._syncTiltUI()
500:       this.setTiltBadge(tiltOn)
501:     }
502:   }

542:   _updateLocation(player, game) {

558:   _updateMinimap(dt, player, storm, game) {
559:     this.mapAccum += dt
560:     if (this.mapAccum < 0.1) return
561:     this.mapAccum = 0
562:     const ctx = this.ctx
563:     const size = 188
564:     const c = size / 2
565:     const scale = 88 / 300
566:     const M = (x, z) => [c + x * scale, c + z * scale]
567: 
568:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size)
569:     const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(c, c, 10, c, c, c)
570:     bg.addColorStop(0, '#0f4d66')
571:     bg.addColorStop(1, '#082638')
572:     ctx.fillStyle = bg
573:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size)
574:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160, 220, 255, 0.07)'
575:     ctx.lineWidth = 1
576:     for (let r = 30; r < 100; r += 25) {
577:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c, c, r, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke()
578:     }
579:     // island
580:     ctx.beginPath()
581:     this._coast.outer.forEach(([x, z], i) => {
582:       const [px, py] = M(x, z)
583:       i ? ctx.lineTo(px, py) : ctx.moveTo(px, py)
584:     })
585:     ctx.closePath()
586:     ctx.fillStyle = '#d9c292'
587:     ctx.fill()
588:     ctx.lineWidth = 2
589:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 235, 190, 0.5)'
590:     ctx.stroke()
591:     ctx.beginPath()
592:     this._coast.inner.forEach(([x, z], i) => {
593:       const [px, py] = M(x, z)
594:       i ? ctx.lineTo(px, py) : ctx.moveTo(px, py)
595:     })
596:     ctx.closePath()
597:     const land = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, size)
598:     land.addColorStop(0, '#7fb967')
599:     land.addColorStop(1, '#5b9d58')
600:     ctx.fillStyle = land
601:     ctx.fill()
602:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(38, 83, 52, 0.35)'
603:     ctx.lineWidth = 1
604:     ctx.stroke()
605: 
606:     // POIs
607:     for (const p of this.game.world.poiMarkers || []) {
608:       const [px, py] = M(p.x, p.z)
609:       ctx.beginPath()
610:       ctx.arc(px, py, 3.4, 0, TAU)
611:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 16, 30, 0.65)'
612:       ctx.fill()
613:       ctx.beginPath()
614:       ctx.arc(px, py, 2, 0, TAU)
615:       ctx.fillStyle = p.color || '#ffda7a'
616:       ctx.fill()
617:       if (size > 150) {
618:         ctx.font = '600 7px Outfit, sans-serif'
619:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.65)'
620:         ctx.textAlign = 'center'
621:         ctx.fillText(p.name.toUpperCase(), px, py + 10)
622:       }
623:     }
624: 
625:     // storm: shade everything outside the safe circle
626:     const [sx, sy] = M(storm.center.x, storm.center.y)
627:     const sr = storm.radius * scale
628:     ctx.save()
629:     ctx.beginPath()
630:     ctx.rect(0, 0, size, size)
631:     ctx.arc(sx, sy, Math.max(0, sr), 0, TAU, true)
632:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(153, 83, 255, 0.36)'
633:     ctx.fill('evenodd')
634:     ctx.restore()
635:     ctx.beginPath()
636:     ctx.arc(sx, sy, Math.max(0, sr), 0, TAU)
637:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200, 160, 255, 0.9)'
638:     ctx.lineWidth = 1.6
639:     ctx.stroke()
640: 
641:     const next = storm.nextCircle
642:     if (next) {
643:       const [nx, ny] = M(next.x, next.z)
644:       ctx.save()
645:       ctx.setLineDash([4, 3])
646:       ctx.beginPath()
647:       ctx.arc(nx, ny, next.r * scale, 0, TAU)
648:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.75)'
649:       ctx.lineWidth = 1.2
650:       ctx.stroke()
651:       ctx.restore()
652:     }
653: 
654:     // enemies within radar range
655:     for (const bot of game.bots) {
656:       if (!bot.alive) continue
657:       const d = Math.hypot(bot.pos.x - player.pos.x, bot.pos.z - player.pos.z)
658:       if (d > 85) continue
659:       const [bx, by] = M(bot.pos.x, bot.pos.z)
660:       ctx.beginPath()
661:       ctx.arc(bx, by, 2.2, 0, TAU)
662:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b5b'
663:       ctx.shadowColor = '#ff5b5b'
664:       ctx.shadowBlur = 4
665:       ctx.fill()
666:       ctx.shadowBlur = 0
667:     }
668: 
669:     // player arrow
670:     const [px, py] = M(player.pos.x, player.pos.z)
671:     const fx = Math.sin(player.camYaw)
672:     const fz = Math.cos(player.camYaw)
673:     const rx = -Math.cos(player.camYaw)
674:     const rz = Math.sin(player.camYaw)
675:     const tipX = px + fx * 8
676:     const tipY = py + fz * 8
677:     const backX = px - fx * 4
678:     const backY = py - fz * 4
679:     ctx.beginPath()
680:     ctx.moveTo(tipX, tipY)
681:     ctx.lineTo(backX + rx * 5, backY + rz * 5)
682:     ctx.lineTo(backX - rx * 5, backY - rz * 5)

playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file
  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)
  cookie-get <name>           get a specific cookie by name
  cookie-set <name> <value>   set a cookie with optional flags
  cookie-delete <name>        delete a specific cookie
  cookie-clear                clear all cookies
  localstorage-list           list all localstorage key-value pairs
  localstorage-get <key>      get a localstorage item by key
  localstorage-set <key> <value> set a localstorage item
  localstorage-delete <key>   delete a localstorage item
  localstorage-clear          clear all localstorage
  sessionstorage-list         list all sessionstorage key-value pairs
  sessionstorage-get <key>    get a sessionstorage item by key
  sessionstorage-set <key> <value> set a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-delete <key> delete a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-clear        clear all sessionstorage

Network:
  requests                    list all network requests since loading the page. each request is numbered for use with the `request` command.
  request <index>             show full details (headers, body, response) of a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-headers <index>     print only the request headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-body <index>        print only the request body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-headers <index>    print only the response headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-body <index>       print the response body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command. textual bodies are inlined; binary bodies are saved to a file and the path is printed.
  route <pattern>             mock network requests matching a url pattern
  route-list                  list all active network routes
  unroute [pattern]           remove routes matching a pattern (or all routes)
  network-state-set <state>   set the browser network state to online or offline

DevTools:
  console [min-level]         list console messages
  run-code [code]             run playwright code snippet
  recording-start             start recording user actions
  recording-stop              stop recording user actions and print them as playwright code
  tracing-start               start trace recording
  tracing-stop                stop trace recording
  video-start [filename]      start video recording
  video-stop                  stop video recording
  video-chapter <title>       add a chapter marker to the video recording
  video-show-actions          annotate subsequent cli/mcp actions on the page with a callout that names the action and highlights the target element
  video-hide-actions          stop annotating actions performed on the page
  show                        show playwright dashboard
  pause-at <location>         run the test up to a specific location and pause there
  resume                      resume the test execution
  step-over                   step over the next call in the test
  generate-locator <target>   generate a playwright locator for the given element
  highlight [target]          show (or with --hide, remove) a highlight overlay for an element; `--hide` without a target hides all page highlights.

Install:
  install                     initialize workspace
  install-browser [browser]   install browser

Browser sessions:
  list                        list browser sessions
  close-all                   close all browser sessions
  kill-all                    forcefully kill all browser sessions (for stale/zombie processes)

Global options:
  --help [command]            print help
  --json                      output response as JSON
  --raw                       output only the result value, without status and code
  --version                   print version

1: # Stormfall Royale
2: 
3: A fast, mobile-first battle royale that runs entirely in the browser. Drop onto a stylized island, loot chests, outlast the shrinking storm, and be the last of 16 fighters standing. Built as an original game — no Fortnite assets, branding, or trademarks.
4: 
5: **Play:** open `index.html` through any static server, or run `PORT=3002 ./start.sh` from this folder.
6: 
7: ## Features
8: 
9: - **16-player solo match** — you versus 15 bots with drop, loot, and combat AI.
10: - **Touch-first controls** — virtual joystick, drag-to-aim, and large action buttons with safe-area-aware HUD.
11: - **Optional tilt aiming** — lean your phone to fine-tune your shot. On iOS, motion access is requested from a user gesture (the tilt switch) and can be revoked at any time.
12: - **Desktop controls** — WASD movement, pointer-lock mouse aim, click to fire, plus full keyboard shortcuts.
13: - **Five points of interest** — each with its own silhouette, loot density, and chest placement.
14: - **Loot and rarities** — chests and floor loot grant weapons, shield potions, and building materials. Five rarity tiers from common to legendary.
15: - **Two weapon slots + pickaxe** — swap instantly, reload, and harvest wood with the pickaxe.
16: - **Building** — place walls and ramps in real time using harvested wood.
17: - **Shrinking storm** — multiple phases with escalating damage, visible storm wall, and a live minimap.
18: - **Original audiovisual style** — procedural low-poly island, stylized characters and gliders, synthesized WebAudio sound effects, and locally vendored fonts.
19: - **Full match flow** — menu, drop/glide intro, live HUD, killfeed, victory and defeat screens with stats, pause, settings, and instant rematch.
20: - **Performance options** — high and balanced quality presets; auto-pauses when the tab is hidden.
21: 
22: ## Controls
23: 
24: ### Desktop
25: 
26: | Action | Input |
27: | --- | --- |
28: | Move | `W` `A` `S` `D` or arrow keys |
29: | Sprint | `Shift` |
30: | Aim | Mouse (click the game to lock the pointer) |
31: | Fire | Left click |
32: | Aim down sights | Right click |
33: | Jump | `Space` |
34: | Reload | `R` |
35: | Build mode | `B` |
36: | Cycle build piece | `Q` |
37: | Place build | Left click or `F` |
38: | Switch weapon / pickaxe | `X` or `1` `2` `3` |
39: | Interact / open chest | `E` |
40: | Pause | `Esc` |
41: 
42: ### Mobile / tablet
43: 
44: | Action | Input |
45: | --- | --- |
46: | Move | Left virtual joystick |
47: | Aim | Drag anywhere on the right side of the screen |
48: | Fire | Fire button (hold for automatic weapons) |
49: | Aim down sights | Aim button |
50: | Jump | Jump button |
51: | Reload | Reload button |
52: | Build / place | Build button, then tap the placement control |
53: | Switch weapon | Weapon slot buttons |
54: | Open chest | Interact button when prompted |
55: | Tilt aim | Settings → Tilt aiming (optional) |
56: 
57: The touch HUD appears automatically on coarse-pointer devices or narrow viewports, and respects display safe areas (notches, home indicators).
58: 
59: ## Project layout
60: 
61: ```
62: index.html          Markup, HUD, menus, modals, import map
63: styles.css          Responsive visual system and touch layout
64: src/main.js         Game boot, match loop, combat bridge, flow
65: src/player.js       Player controller, camera, shooting, building
66: src/bot.js          Bot models, drop, AI, combat
67: src/world.js        Island, POIs, colliders, chests, storm
68: src/character.js    Character, glider, and health-bar models
69: src/weapons.js      Weapon stats, rarities, procedural meshes
70: src/input.js        Touch, keyboard, mouse, and tilt input
71: src/ui.js           HUD, minimap, menus, killfeed, end screens
72: src/fx.js           Particles, tracers, muzzle flash
73: src/audio.js        Synthesized WebAudio sound effects
74: vendor/             Locally vendored Three.js
75: assets/             Locally vendored fonts
76: ```
77: 
78: ## Technical notes
79: 
80: - No build step and no framework; ES modules load directly via an import map.
81: - Three.js is vendored locally, so the game works offline once served.
82: - All geometry, textures, and sound effects are generated procedurally at runtime.
83: - Rendering falls back gracefully on software GPUs; use the Balanced quality preset for lower-end devices.

playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url

558:   _updateMinimap(dt, player, storm, game) {
559:     this.mapAccum += dt
560:     if (this.mapAccum < 0.1) return
561:     this.mapAccum = 0
562:     const ctx = this.ctx
563:     const size = 188
564:     const c = size / 2
565:     const scale = 88 / 300
566:     const M = (x, z) => [c + x * scale, c + z * scale]
567: 
568:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size)
569:     const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(c, c, 10, c, c, c)
570:     bg.addColorStop(0, '#0f4d66')
571:     bg.addColorStop(1, '#082638')
572:     ctx.fillStyle = bg
573:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size)
574:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160, 220, 255, 0.07)'
575:     ctx.lineWidth = 1
576:     for (let r = 30; r < 100; r += 25) {
577:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c, c, r, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke()
578:     }
579:     // island
580:     ctx.beginPath()
581:     this._coast.outer.forEach(([x, z], i) => {
582:       const [px, py] = M(x, z)
583:       i ? ctx.lineTo(px, py) : ctx.moveTo(px, py)
584:     })
585:     ctx.closePath()
586:     ctx.fillStyle = '#d9c292'
587:     ctx.fill()
588:     ctx.lineWidth = 2
589:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 235, 190, 0.5)'
590:     ctx.stroke()
591:     ctx.beginPath()
592:     this._coast.inner.forEach(([x, z], i) => {
593:       const [px, py] = M(x, z)
594:       i ? ctx.lineTo(px, py) : ctx.moveTo(px, py)
595:     })
596:     ctx.closePath()
597:     const land = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, size)
598:     land.addColorStop(0, '#7fb967')
599:     land.addColorStop(1, '#5b9d58')
600:     ctx.fillStyle = land
601:     ctx.fill()
602:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(38, 83, 52, 0.35)'
603:     ctx.lineWidth = 1
604:     ctx.stroke()
605: 
606:     // POIs
607:     for (const p of this.game.world.poiMarkers || []) {
608:       const [px, py] = M(p.x, p.z)
609:       ctx.beginPath()
610:       ctx.arc(px, py, 3.4, 0, TAU)
611:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 16, 30, 0.65)'
612:       ctx.fill()
613:       ctx.beginPath()
614:       ctx.arc(px, py, 2, 0, TAU)
615:       ctx.fillStyle = p.color || '#ffda7a'
616:       ctx.fill()
617:       if (size > 150) {
618:         ctx.font = '600 7px Outfit, sans-serif'
619:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.65)'
620:         ctx.textAlign = 'center'
621:         ctx.fillText(p.name.toUpperCase(), px, py + 10)
622:       }
623:     }
624: 
625:     // storm: shade everything outside the safe circle
626:     const [sx, sy] = M(storm.center.x, storm.center.y)
627:     const sr = storm.radius * scale
628:     ctx.save()
629:     ctx.beginPath()
630:     ctx.rect(0, 0, size, size)
631:     ctx.arc(sx, sy, Math.max(0, sr), 0, TAU, true)
632:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(153, 83, 255, 0.36)'
633:     ctx.fill('evenodd')
634:     ctx.restore()
635:     ctx.beginPath()
636:     ctx.arc(sx, sy, Math.max(0, sr), 0, TAU)
637:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200, 160, 255, 0.9)'
638:     ctx.lineWidth = 1.6
639:     ctx.stroke()
640: 
641:     const next = storm.nextCircle
642:     if (next) {
643:       const [nx, ny] = M(next.x, next.z)
644:       ctx.save()
645:       ctx.setLineDash([4, 3])
646:       ctx.beginPath()
647:       ctx.arc(nx, ny, next.r * scale, 0, TAU)
648:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.75)'
649:       ctx.lineWidth = 1.2
650:       ctx.stroke()
651:       ctx.restore()
652:     }
653: 
654:     // enemies within radar range
655:     for (const bot of game.bots) {
656:       if (!bot.alive) continue
657:       const d = Math.hypot(bot.pos.x - player.pos.x, bot.pos.z - player.pos.z)
658:       if (d > 85) continue
659:       const [bx, by] = M(bot.pos.x, bot.pos.z)
660:       ctx.beginPath()
661:       ctx.arc(bx, by, 2.2, 0, TAU)
662:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5b5b'
663:       ctx.shadowColor = '#ff5b5b'
664:       ctx.shadowBlur = 4
665:       ctx.fill()
666:       ctx.shadowBlur = 0
667:     }
668: 
669:     // player arrow
670:     const [px, py] = M(player.pos.x, player.pos.z)
671:     const fx = Math.sin(player.camYaw)
672:     const fz = Math.cos(player.camYaw)
673:     const rx = -Math.cos(player.camYaw)
674:     const rz = Math.sin(player.camYaw)
675:     const tipX = px + fx * 8
676:     const tipY = py + fz * 8
677:     const backX = px - fx * 4
678:     const backY = py - fz * 4
679:     ctx.beginPath()
680:     ctx.moveTo(tipX, tipY)
681:     ctx.lineTo(backX + rx * 5, backY + rz * 5)
682:     ctx.lineTo(backX - rx * 5, backY - rz * 5)
683:     ctx.closePath()
684:     ctx.fillStyle = '#5ce6ff'
685:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(4, 20, 30, 0.85)'
686:     ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
687:     ctx.fill()
688:     ctx.stroke()
689:     ctx.beginPath()
690:     ctx.arc(px, py, 1.5, 0, TAU)
691:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'
692:     ctx.fill()
693: 
694:     // compass
695:     ctx.font = '800 9px Outfit, sans-serif'
696:     ctx.textAlign = 'center'
697:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.55)'
698:     ctx.fillText('N', c, 12)
699:     ctx.fillText('S', c, size - 5)
700:     ctx.fillText('W', 7, c + 3)
701:     ctx.fillText('E', size - 7, c + 3)
702:   }

199:   _makeCoast() {
200:     const outer = []
201:     const inner = []
202:     const world = this.world
203:     for (let i = 0; i < 96; i++) {
204:       const a = (i / 96) * TAU
205:       let lo = 20, hi = 320
206:       for (let k = 0; k < 18; k++) {
207:         const m = (lo + hi) / 2
208:         if (world.heightAt(Math.cos(a) * m, Math.sin(a) * m) > 0.3) lo = m
209:         else hi = m
210:       }
211:       outer.push([Math.cos(a) * lo, Math.sin(a) * lo])
212:       let lo2 = 20, hi2 = lo
213:       for (let k = 0; k < 14; k++) {
214:         const m = (lo2 + hi2) / 2
215:         if (world.heightAt(Math.cos(a) * m, Math.sin(a) * m) > 2.2) lo2 = m
216:         else hi2 = m
217:       }
218:       inner.push([Math.cos(a) * lo2, Math.sin(a) * lo2])
219:     }
220:     return { outer, inner }
221:   }

426:   update(dt) {
427:     if (!this.playing) return
428:     const game = this.game
429:     const player = game.player
430:     const storm = game.world.storm
431:     if (!player) return
432: 
433:     const alive = game.bots.reduce((n, b) => n + (b.alive ? 1 : 0), 0) + (player.alive ? 1 : 0)
434:     if (this.last.alive !== alive) {
435:       this.els.alive.textContent = alive
436:       this.last.alive = alive
437:     }
438: 
439:     const label = storm.label
440:     const time = storm.phase === 'final' ? '—' : fmtTime(storm.countdown)
441:     if (this.last.storm !== label + time) {
442:       this.els.stormTimer.textContent = time
443:       this.els.stormLabel.textContent = label
444:       this.els.stormPill.classList.toggle('danger', storm.countdown < 9 && storm.phase !== 'final')
445:       this.last.storm = label + time
446:     }
447:     const dots = this.els.phaseDots.children
448:     for (let i = 0; i < dots.length; i++) {
449:       dots[i].className = i < storm.index ? 'done' : i === storm.index ? 'now' : ''
450:     }
451: 
452:     const hp = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(player.hp))
453:     const sh = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(player.shield))
454:     this.els.healthFill.style.width = clamp((player.hp / player.maxHp) * 100, 0, 100) + '%'
455:     this.els.shieldFill.style.width = clamp((player.shield / player.maxShield) * 100, 0, 100) + '%'
456:     if (this.last.hp !== hp) { this.els.healthText.textContent = hp; this.last.hp = hp }
457:     if (this.last.sh !== sh) { this.els.shieldText.textContent = sh; this.last.sh = sh }
458:     this.els.healthRow.classList.toggle('low', player.hp < 35)
459:     const low = player.hp < 35 && player.alive ? 0.3 + Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.006) * 0.16 : 0
460:     this.els.lowHealth.style.opacity = low.toFixed(2)
461: 
462:     const wood = Math.floor(player.wood)
463:     if (this.last.wood !== wood) {
464:       this.els.wood.textContent = wood
465:       this.els.buildWood.textContent = wood
466:       this.last.wood = wood
467:     }
468: 
469:     const current = player.current
470:     if (this.last.slot !== current) {
471:       this.els.weaponSlots.forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle('active', i === current))
472:       this.last.slot = current
473:     }
474:     this._updateSlots(player)
475: 
476:     this.els.reloadRing.classList.toggle('show', player.reloadT > 0)
477:     if (player.reloadT > 0 && player.reloadTotal > 0) {
478:       this.els.reloadRing.style.setProperty('--p', String(1 - player.reloadT / player.reloadTotal))
479:     }
480: 
481:     this._updateMinimap(dt, player, storm, game)
482:     this._updateLocation(player, game)
483: 
484:     this.bloom = Math.max(0, this.bloom - dt * 2.4)
485:     const gap = (this.aiming ? 4 : 7) + this.bloom * 9
486:     this.els.crosshair.style.setProperty('--gap', gap.toFixed(1) + 'px')
487: 
488:     this.damageFlash = Math.max(0, this.damageFlash - dt * 1.8)
489:     this.els.damageVignette.style.opacity = (this.damageFlash * 0.9).toFixed(2)
490:     const outside = storm.outside(player.pos.x, player.pos.z, 0.5) && player.state === 'active'
491:     this.stormOpacity = lerp(this.stormOpacity, outside ? 0.85 : 0, 1 - Math.exp(-3 * dt))
492:     this.els.stormVignette.style.opacity = this.stormOpacity.toFixed(2)
493: 
494:     const tiltOn = Boolean(player.input?.tiltOn)
495:     const tiltStatus = player.input?.tiltStatus
496:     if (this.last.tiltOn !== tiltOn || this.last.tiltStatus !== tiltStatus) {
497:       this.last.tiltOn = tiltOn
498:       this.last.tiltStatus = tiltStatus
499:       this._syncTiltUI()
500:       this.setTiltBadge(tiltOn)
501:     }
502:   }

504:   _updateSlots(player) {
505:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
506:       const el = this.els.weaponSlots[i]
507:       const ammo = this.els.wammo[i]
508:       let weapon = null
509:       if (i === 0) weapon = null
510:       else weapon = player.weapons[i - 1]
511:       const isPick = i === 0
512:       el.classList.toggle('empty', !isPick && !weapon)
513:       if (isPick) {
514:         el.style.setProperty('--rarity', '#8fa3b8')
515:         el.style.setProperty('--fill', '100%')
516:         ammo.textContent = '∞'
517:         const name = el.querySelector('.wslot-name')
518:         if (name.textContent !== 'PICKAXE') name.textContent = 'PICKAXE'
519:         const ico = el.querySelector('.wslot-ico')
520:         if (!ico.dataset.pick) {
521:           ico.dataset.pick = '1'
522:           ico.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 20 14.5 9.5M12.5 4.6l6.9 6.9M9.7 7.6l3 3M17 3l4 4-2.4 1.2-2.8-2.8z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>'
523:         }
524:       } else if (weapon) {
525:         el.style.setProperty('--rarity', weapon.color)
526:         el.style.setProperty('--fill', clamp((weapon.mag / weapon.magSize) * 100, 0, 100) + '%')
527:         ammo.textContent = `${weapon.mag}/${weapon.reserve}`

1: # Stormfall Royale
2: 
3: A fast, mobile-first battle royale that runs entirely in the browser. Drop onto a stylized island, loot chests, outlast the shrinking storm, and be the last of 16 fighters standing. Built as an original game — no Fortnite assets, branding, or trademarks.
4: 
5: **Play:** open `index.html` through any static server, or run `PORT=3002 ./start.sh` from this folder.
6: 
7: ## Features
8: 
9: - **16-player solo match** — you versus 15 bots with drop, loot, and combat AI.
10: - **Touch-first controls** — virtual joystick, drag-to-aim, and large action buttons with safe-area-aware HUD.
11: - **Optional tilt aiming** — lean your phone to fine-tune your shot. On iOS, motion access is requested from a user gesture (the tilt switch) and can be revoked at any time.
12: - **Desktop controls** — WASD movement, pointer-lock mouse aim, click to fire, plus full keyboard shortcuts.
13: - **Five points of interest** — each with its own silhouette, loot density, and chest placement.
14: - **Loot and rarities** — chests and floor loot grant weapons, shield potions, and building materials. Five rarity tiers from common to legendary.
15: - **Two weapon slots + pickaxe** — swap instantly, reload, and harvest wood with the pickaxe.
16: - **Building** — place walls and ramps in real time using harvested wood.
17: - **Shrinking storm** — multiple phases with escalating damage, visible storm wall, and a live minimap.
18: - **Original audiovisual style** — procedural low-poly island, stylized characters and gliders, synthesized WebAudio sound effects, and locally vendored fonts.
19: - **Full match flow** — menu, drop/glide intro, live HUD, killfeed, victory and defeat screens with stats, pause, settings, and instant rematch.
20: - **Performance options** — high and balanced quality presets; auto-pauses when the tab is hidden.
21: 
22: ## Controls
23: 
24: ### Desktop
25: 
26: | Action | Input |
27: | --- | --- |
28: | Move | `W` `A` `S` `D` or arrow keys |
29: | Sprint | `Shift` |
30: | Aim | Mouse (click the game to lock the pointer) |
31: | Fire | Left click |
32: | Aim down sights | Right click |
33: | Jump | `Space` |
34: | Reload | `R` |
35: | Build mode | `B` |
36: | Cycle build piece | `Q` |
37: | Place build | Left click or `F` |
38: | Switch weapon / pickaxe | `X` or `1` `2` `3` |
39: | Interact / open chest | `E` |
40: | Pause | `Esc` |
41: 
42: ### Mobile / tablet
43: 
44: | Action | Input |
45: | --- | --- |
46: | Move | Left virtual joystick |
47: | Aim | Drag anywhere on the right side of the screen |
48: | Fire | Fire button (hold for automatic weapons) |
49: | Aim down sights | Aim button |
50: | Jump | Jump button |
51: | Reload | Reload button |
52: | Build / place | Build button, then tap the placement control |
53: | Switch weapon | Weapon slot buttons |
54: | Open chest | Interact button when prompted |
55: | Tilt aim | Settings → Tilt aiming (optional) |
56: 
57: The touch HUD appears automatically on coarse-pointer devices or narrow viewports, and respects display safe areas (notches, home indicators).
58: 
59: ## Project layout
60: 
61: ```
62: index.html          Markup, HUD, menus, modals, import map
63: styles.css          Responsive visual system and touch layout
64: src/main.js         Game boot, match loop, combat bridge, flow
65: src/player.js       Player controller, camera, shooting, building
66: src/bot.js          Bot models, drop, AI, combat
67: src/world.js        Island, POIs, colliders, chests, storm
68: src/character.js    Character, glider, and health-bar models
69: src/weapons.js      Weapon stats, rarities, procedural meshes
70: src/input.js        Touch, keyboard, mouse, and tilt input
71: src/ui.js           HUD, minimap, menus, killfeed, end screens
72: src/fx.js           Particles, tracers, muzzle flash
73: src/audio.js        Synthesized WebAudio sound effects
74: vendor/             Locally vendored Three.js
75: assets/             Locally vendored fonts
76: ```
77: 
78: ## Technical notes
79: 
80: - No build step and no framework; ES modules load directly via an import map.
81: - Three.js is vendored locally, so the game works offline once served.
82: - All geometry, textures, and sound effects are generated procedurally at runtime.
83: - Rendering falls back gracefully on software GPUs; use the Balanced quality preset for lower-end devices.
